summary: Made click.edit accept os.PathLike filenames. In src/click/termui.py added `import os`, broadened `filename` to `str | os.PathLike[str] | cabc.Iterable[str | os.PathLike[str]] | None` in both overloads and the implementation, wrapped single paths via `isinstance(filename, (str, os.PathLike))`, extended the `:param filename:` docstring, and added a `.. versionchanged:: 8.5.0` note. In src/click/_termui_impl.py annotated `Editor.edit_files` as `cabc.Iterable[str | os.PathLike[str]]`; its body already passes filenames to subprocess.Popen, so no body change was needed. Appended the CHANGES.md entry. `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_termui.py` passed: 259 passed, 23 skipped.
concerns: Verify the new typing test tests/typing/typing_edit.py type-checks (mypy not installed in this venv, so it was not run).
Confirm the multi-line parenthesized annotation formatting in termui.py matches repo style (ruff not available to confirm).
